title: Standing Reserve Basis for Paloma Business Withdrawals
content:
On a withdrawal from a Paloma Business balance, the reserve basis, the payout principal the standing reserve is a percentage of, depends on the payouts submitted in the three months before the day of the withdrawal, counted from the day after the same calendar day three months earlier up to and including that day.

### Decision

An account that submitted 12 or more payouts in that window has its standing reserve based on the payout principal debited in the month before the day of the withdrawal, counted from the day after the same calendar day one month earlier; an account that submitted no payout in that window has it based on the payout principal debited in the six months before that day, counted the same way; every other account has it based on the payout principal of the three months.

| Payouts submitted in the three-month window | Reserve basis |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | Payout principal debited in the past month |
| 1 to 11 | Payout principal debited in the past three months |
| None | Payout principal debited in the past six months |

### Cases (hypothetical, withdrawal on 15 September)

- 14 payouts submitted from 16 June through 15 September: the basis is the principal debited from 16 August through 15 September.
- 5 payouts in the three months: the basis is the principal debited from 16 June through 15 September.
- No payout in the three months: the basis is the principal debited from 16 March through 15 September.
